response.overview: In a barber shop where Professor Bing comes to get shaved there is funny business between the occupants and in the excitement the barber inadvertently massages Professor Bing with shoe paste. The first of the cartoons is "Dr. E. Z. Bear's Busy Day." Visited by a giraffe, stricken with "mushroomatis" Dr. Bear gets a ladder, nd saws off the mushroom growing out of the giraffe's neck. A leopard goes in for treatment, which consists of hammering vacillant to the satisfaction of the leopard. "One Hundred Years of Fashion Slavery" shows the evolution of garb for women. It shows which will be worn in 1920. "The Hicks in Nightmareland" the last cartoon. Hercules of dwarfed proportions, undertakes to reproach the brawny janitor for the dearth of hot water in the flat. As Hercules delivers his tirade, he realizes his insignificance and dwindles away until a small puddle remains. The janitor, sees the puddle and rubs the mop over it and then disappears into his flat
response.title: Cartoons in the Barber Shop
